# GenkiArm / LeRobot Source Boundary

This directory contains a focused source redistribution from:

- Source: <https://gitee.com/huahuaze/genkiarm>
- Commit: `d177f9f455eb5e00a41ccf20e786c436a4fc0d86`
- License: Apache License 2.0

Included material is limited to Python source, robot configuration, package metadata and the upstream license/notice required to inspect the leader–follower integration path. Generated bytecode, calibration cache, datasets, model outputs, camera captures, media and robot meshes are intentionally absent.

The repository root MIT License does not apply to this directory. See [`LICENSE`](LICENSE), [`NOTICE.txt`](NOTICE.txt) and the repository-level [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Primary Entries

- `lerobot/configs/robot/so100.yaml`
- `lerobot/scripts/control_robot.py`
- `lerobot/common/robot_devices/motors/gbot.py`
- `lerobot/common/robot_devices/motors/feetech.py`

This source presence is not hardware or runtime evidence. Local serial ports, cameras, calibration files and safety limits must be established for the actual system.
